{{Skl|Carpentry}} is one of the [[Skills]] that players can level up by [[Crafting]] items. It allows the player to craft and use Carpentry items using the {{Item|Carpentry Table}}.<!-- Carpentry is a cosmetic-only mechanic.-->

The skill is unlocked after giving the {{NPCSprite|Carpenter}} {{Item|Wool|amount=64}}, who will then reward the player with the recipe for the {{Item|Carpentry Table}}.

At {{Skill|Carpentry|3}}, the player unlocks [[Crafting#Quick Crafting|Quick Crafting]], which allows them to instantly craft an item, as long as they have the required materials in their inventory. However, it is only available to players with the {{Rank|vip}} rank and above. On {{Gamemode|Bingo}} profiles, it is available to all players, including those without a rank. On {{Gamemode|Stranded}} profiles, it is only available to {{Rank|vip+}} players and above.
<!--

[[Roman Numerals]] are used to express its levels in-game.-->

== Furniture ==
{{Main|Furniture}}
Carpentry is the main way to obtain [[Furniture]], which can be crafted using the {{Item|Carpentry Table}}.

== Leveling Up ==
The player can level up {{Skill|Carpentry}} by crafting items. The XP gained is {{Green|3%}} of the combined NPC sell price of the ingredients used to craft the item. Most vanilla recipes do not grant Carpentry XP.

{{/Leveling Rewards}}

== Tips ==
* Crafting [[Sapphire Power Scroll]]s can be a good way of leveling {{skill|carpentry}}. It gives a decent amount of {{skill|carpentry|XP}} while profiting from selling the Power Scrolls on the Auction House.
* For a Bazaar-Only approach, forum user [https://hypixel.net/members/prekoyte.6408165/ Prekoyte] has developed [https://skyblocktools.dev/carpentry-xp-calculator an online tool to calculate the most efficient crafts for Carpentry XP].

== Trivia ==
*Upgrading to {{Skl|Carpentry|4}} or above used to require {{Rank|VIP}} before SkyBlock 0.14.
*{{Skl|Carpentry}} used to have an XP multiplier that differed between [[Ranks]]. It was subsequently removed in SkyBlock 0.14.<!--
** {{Rank|br=false|Default}}: x1.0, Max level 3
** {{Rank|br=false|VIP}}: x1.1
** {{Rank|br=false|VIP+}}: x1.25
** {{Rank|br=false|MVP}}: x1.5
** {{Rank|br=false|MVP+}}: x2
** {{Rank|br=false|MVP++}}: x3-->
*Crafting items in the vanilla 2x2 crafting grid in the player's inventory does not give {{Skl|Carpentry|XP}}, even if it normally does when crafted in the 3x3 crafting grid.
*A player gets experience proportional to how many items are required. It's most efficient to get items which tier up such as {{Item|Perfect Armor}}, {{Item|Base Griffin Upgrade Stone|text=Griffin Upgrade Stones}}, etc.
